summary: TGA texture file scanner. Builds a scan filter from byte_5D3074 into FileName, uses the input path string *this (falling back to byte_5EA438 when null), sets up a directory scan (AllocateStructWithDefaultValues, sub_565EB0, sub_565F80, sub_566380), then iterates directory entries via DirectoryEntryIterator. For each entry it strips the directory and extension, resolves the base name against the requested path, and when it is a match allocates an 8-byte string node (OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper + StringCopyWithBufferRealloc) wrapped in a 12-byte list node that is either appended (exact path match) or prepended (other matches) into the caller result list a2 (a2[0]/a2[1]/a2[2] head/tail, a2[3] count). Returns LinkedListDestructorWithChildCleanup(v24).

operations.description: AllocateStructWithDefaultValues(v24) initializes the directory-scan working structure.
Copy the filter string byte_5D3074 into FileName until a NUL terminator.
Base path: v5 = *this; when *this is null fall back to byte_5EA438, then strcpy into v31.
Strip the directory portion: from the end of v31 walk back to the last backslash (0x5C = 92), zeroing characters after it.
Configure the scan: sub_565EB0(v24), sub_565F80(FileName, 1, v31, 0) sets the filter, sub_566380(0) commits setup.
LinkedListPopFront_5f50(v24) pops the first directory entry.
Iterate directory entries while DirectoryEntryIterator(v24) is non-null.
Per entry: ReversePathSearchForBackslashSeparator(v24) locates the filename, copied with sub_587DD0(v26, v8, 127); then strip extension by zeroing after the last period (0x2E = 46).

Second pass: read the full entry again via DirectoryEntryIterator, copy with sub_587DD0(v29, v10, 511), strip trailing backslash-separated directory components, count backslashes to find the second-level path, and memmove the base name into v28.
Compare stripped base names: when sub_588410(v26, v28) reports a match the entry is skipped (goes to LABEL_54).

Match handling: allocate an 8-byte node with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(8), initialize it, copy the entry string with StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(v19), wrap it in a 12-byte list node and link into the caller result list a2.

Path-match priority: sub_566810(v29, v31) resolves the matched path; exact matches append (goto LABEL_53 after tail link), other matches prepend into the head; on every success increment a2[3] (count).
Return LinkedListDestructorWithChildCleanup(v24), tearing down the scan structure and children.
